g.text: Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: 9 schedule rows of docs-authority/nozzles/MEOH_SYNTH.csv at tag, face and bore

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N1 CO2 and N2 H2 in on -Y at z 160, N8 CO2-not-taken at the pack; N3 crude MeOH, N6 co-feed, N7 synthesis water and N9 mercaptan trace out on +Y at z 600 - datums draw as issued (both fit the 2585 box)

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N4 drain boss under the bottom flange (flush at the envelope bottom, 50 datum); N5 vent riser on the top flange, flush at the envelope top (the 800 datum is the placeholder elevation, W12)
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: Side stubs pierce to the tube axis so every takeoff lands on the vessel; elevations are the schedule placeholders pending vessel design (duty section 4, W12)
